entries.name: corin-faces
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Edit target is the attached 192x192 neutral Corin portrait from Depths. Produce a 3-column by 2-row equal-square-cell animation atlas, transparent background. Each cell is the EXACT same full portrait, same 192x192 normalized registration, size, facial anatomy, gaze, nose, eyebrows, stubble, skin colours, pixel clusters, shoulders, clothes and diffuse neutral lighting as the reference. Do not redesign or improve the character. This atlas corrects visibly mismatched earlier eyes/mouth patches. Only edit the eyelid strokes or inner lip opening, preserving ALL adjacent skin creases, moustache, nose and cheeks. Upper left: eyelids half lowered, eyebrows absolutely unchanged. Upper middle: eyes fully gently closed with creases at the SAME eye sockets. Upper right: barely parted speaking lips, preserve the existing confident crooked smile corners and missing front tooth. Lower left: modest open speaking mouth (small movement, not a shout), same lip corners, subtle lower lip/jaw movement confined to mouth area, missing tooth. Lower middle: small rounded speaking lips, preserve chin/stubble exactly. Lower right: unchanged neutral reference. IMPORTANT: do not shift pupils sideways or brow angles; no square colour patches, new teeth, wider face, moved chin, smoothing, richer detail, skin recolouring or painterly effect. In each cell the only allowed feature areas correspond to original eye rectangle x82..136 y57..77 or mouth rectangle x93..125 y84..101 on the 192x192 reference. Keep all other geometry identical. No labels, text, frame, grid lines, added margins or gutter. Pixel art with broad clusters for192px native export, muted48colours. Transparent exterior.
